description: Add ordered steps (subtasks) to a task so the person sees a checklist; the progress bar fills as steps finish. taskhold_begin already does this for new work. For an existing task: taskhold_start it, then taskhold_plan. Steps don't nest. Returns the task's whole step list with ids. Fails on an unknown task_id, on a step (plan its parent) or past 200 steps per task. Planning a done task adds todo steps but leaves it done; taskhold_start it to reopen.

replace.description: Replace steps that haven't started yet (done and in-progress steps stay). Default false: append.

steps.description: Steps in order, e.g. ["Write the migration", "Update the API", "Add tests"]

task_id.description: The ID of the task to plan

name: taskhold_plan
title: Plan task steps
